product.name: Last Mile Delivery
product.description: Service delivering parcels directly to the final destination with options like door-to-door and counter-to-counter delivery.

product.name: International Delivery
product.description: Service for shipping parcels globally with door-to-door pickup and delivery across countries.

product.name: Fulfillment Services
product.description: Warehouse storage and inventory management service including packing and delivery of orders to final destinations.

product.name: Supply Chain Operations
product.description: Logistics solutions for corporate relocation, heavy and bulky item delivery, and comprehensive supply chain management.

product.name: Document Shipping
product.description: Service for shipping important documents domestically and internationally with tracking and delivery confirmation.
